title: November 21 , 2025 In the...
content_text:
November 21 , 2025
In the middle of the week, I somehow decided to buy a ticket for a Friday night stand-up comedy show. Before this, the only full stand-up performance I had ever watched was a video by Luo Yonghao. I didn’t expect much—my goal was simply to try something new—but I still ended up leaving early.

It’s just like watching movies: if a film doesn’t appeal to you, the fact that it’s showing in a cinema doesn’t mean you have to sit through it there. Rewatching a classic at home can be just as enjoyable. I shouldn’t pick a random activity just because I haven’t gone out for a while.

Anyway, the weekend has begun. Wishing everyone a pleasant one.
The photo above is a sunset I captured on my way home from work.
